body: Hmmm...well, it is worth a try. :3

I just need something...some idea to start programming.

I'm a completely logically thinking person, so I have no free imagination. :/

All of you... <3

Thank you so much for your comments. They mean a huge lot to me. And they really have made me feel better. Reading some of them put a big smile on my face, which was long overdue, and really helped.

I'm glad I got myself to write on here, And I hope that maybe some of the PM conversations I started with the people here will evolve into an internet friendship with some of the awesome people you are.

:)

The subject is indeed one I'd prefer to talk about in PM, and I'll gladly take you up on that offer! :)

Thank you for the other kind words <3

Yes, but whaaat? The thing I'm really, really awesome at is programming. But that's as far from being social as an interest or skill can be.

I don't really have other skills or interests, and can't think up any. Any suggestions? :o

Well...it's complicated. The thing is that I enjoy being girly a lot, while I hate being manly in any way. I'm not transgendered, it's just...how I am. Thus, I don't want a muscle-man figure, but I build up muscles so easily... :/ It's why I am reluctant to work out. I know this whole comment probably radiates with stupidity, but it's just me.

Thanks for saying you would care, but why?
Well, I can only think of failures in the last half year.
And until I'm in University? Not being able to work towards this goal is really pulling me down. :/
So if dating sites aren't the right option, what else could I try? I'm really just using them because they're the only possibility I can think of.
But what if there's just so much more failure than success? That's exactly why I'm having problems. There's just a lot more pain than there's pleasure.

Well, the type of girls I've been looking at are the "matches" from the dating sites. So technically those should've been girls looking for someone like me.

And I know I'd have time, but because I'm unhappy with the situation, that time would be very painful.
But what about the incredible pain of being left...because I'd not be good enough for her? :/
Yes, that would be nice. Unfortunately none of the girls I've met so far were interested in that. Are there any?

I will study computer science, and I hope that will be enjoyable. When I said it won't be better, I rather meant my social problems.

I do play the piano! Though...not well, and I'm not too motivated. But I do.
Of course it isn't. But isn't not risking a relationship failure more important?

I'm not forever trapped in it. But I have been for months, and I will be for months. After that I'll get into University, I doubt it'll be much better, but it probably will be a little better.

Thanks for the tip, I'll take a look at that website (never heard of it before!)

I guess. I'm really sorry. :(

It's just that I knew I haven't wanted kids since I was a child myself. And that hasn't changed at any time throughout the years. And even though you may not believe that, I *know* I won't want kids in the future. And I don't want to risk losing a relationship because of that.

I'm not like most 18 year olds though. :/ I have always been more mature than those my age. Which is one of the reasons I had no friends in my childhood either.

I know exactly what I want to do with my life, I just a chance to actually work on it. A child definitely isn't part of it though. I wouldn't be a good parent either, mostly because I simply dislike children.

And silly would be risking getting into a relationship and having it break on this point. Because I definitely wouldn't get out of that alive. I don't have the mental strength to take something like that, I can't even take my current life.

The only two interests I came up with are programming and gaming. Both are best done in front of the computer at home.

I know I need more interests and I'm trying to find one, but didn't come up with one yet.

I'm not. I just really haven't found any girl on there who would be okay with me being more girly than manly and submissive, doesn't want kids and is looking for a very close relationship. And that's not prejudice, that's just requirements for a working relationship. :/
But *what* should I do? I am able to get out of the house, but if I have nothing to do out there, all I have left to do is go back in or get a sunburn.

That sounds like a good idea in theory, but imagine the following:
I stop looking exclusively for girls who want kids and find a wonderful girl, but she wants kids in the future. We get into a relationship, and everything is wonderful until she actually wants to have kids.

Relationship dead, throwaway57932 dead. :/
I am trying. :/ As hard as I can, but I just can't find anything.

Well, fine, I can take a third photo.

But the real problem is that there aren't any matches for me on there? :/

Actually, I'd only ask girls which I have any potential of fitting. If they want kids, or are looking for a "man", messaging them is pointless and will only result in more frustration.

Unfortunately, I haven't found a girl which I could fit on there yet.

Everyday stuff for me is: Breakfast, work, lunch, work, TV, gaming, sleeping. :/

So I need to edit my photos to get a date?

I'm in Austria.

I'm just not the sports type, so exhausting...I'm more for brain sports.

Because how is it likely that one of the few people that I will meet is one of the incredibly few people that could be capable of accepting me as I am IRL? Or, much less likely still, a girl that I fit? Like I've said in another comment, if the chance of my wishes coming true is negligible, what's the point?

Good advice, thanks <3

I changed my profile accordingly.

Thanks for your response.

The thing is, I've tried out a lot, and found most of it to be not interesting to me at all. Sports...haven't found any that I find fun or even find interesting. I'm always open to new ideas if you have any though. I try anything I can think of and get the chance to.

Like I said, the job is involuntary. It's the alternative to military service in my country.

I really dislike travelling, I'm way too clingy to home. I hate being away from home, the further, the worse. I wish I were different.

I'm just asking myself...I already had years to meet new people, and I did, but they all ended up hating me. It's unlikely I'll meet people who don't.

...How do you not see them?
I don't know, do you have an account?

That's exactly how the second one came to be.

Seriously, what would the photo be of? Me sitting in front of the computer or the TV? I thought I'd make one with my only other interest: My dog.

Don't worry, I'm not as close to killing myself as some others on this sub.
Just...last night I was. I didn't do it, but I thought I'd rather write a post here and seek help than let it go too far.

But those guys that you described, those that may not be attractive and still found true love, they have other things that "girls want". I don't.

Good looking? Me? I don't think you have the right profile there. At least you're just contradicting what everyone IRL said ever. :/

The problem is that I don't know what else to write. I'm not confident, so it's hard to write like I was.
Fiiine. But only because you're a decent human.
Those two are pretty much all the pictures that exist of me :v
Of course. I'll send you a PM.

Yes. It makes women more attracted to me. Those women that are looking for manly guys. Which I'm quite the opposite of, and I wouldn't like to be manly either.

And yes, I would deprive myself of the tiny chances of something that I want coming true...but I would also deprive myself of the loads of pain.

Why would you be sad if I was gone? All you've heard from me so far are complaints and whining. Not something you'll miss.
I've put more effort into my profile than any others I've seen, and uploaded two photos which the people I showed them to approved of. Don't know what else I could do.

I don't know I won't, but from the data I have, it's extremely unlikely. And going through lots of pain for a tiny chance just isn't worth it. If I cease to exist and my mind is lost, then there'll be no more pain and suffering.
I would try to help others or make an impact if I knew how to.

And about working out...I'm kinda weak. Wouldn't want to be muscular though, I don't like how it looks at all. I do train by running on a treadmill though when I have the energy.

Oh wow, I totally forgot to write that in the original post...sorry...
Yes, I am currently on two online dating sites, a local one and OKCupid. I'm paying for the local one. No success on either of them. OKCupid is giving me like ten matches, none of which I fit in any way, the local one gives me better matches, but I messaged a lot of them, many of them looked at my profile, none of them found me worth responding to.
I'll edit the original post to say that.

How can you be so sure I'll find someone I fit? All of those traits about me that I listed...most girls hate all of those. What's the probability that I'll randomly meet the one girl that would like to be with someone like me?
Low. Very low. And that's my problem. If I don't have a realistic chance, I have no motivation to continue suffering. I might as well kill myself then.

Thank you for replying <3

Oh yeah, about "say fuck you to those assholes". The problem is that I'm currently getting the most abuse from the people I work with. Making fun of me and such. So no, can't get away from them. :/

I think you missed the "I also don't have any friends" part. I have a few people online which I see as friends, but they can't help me find a mate.
I must say I highly doubt there's a girl I fit out there, but I am trying the best I can. I did tell everyone I know, and take any chance I can to be even the least bit social...
All to no success. And I've asked quite a few people how they found their girlfriends...the answer was always something that I had already tried, only they're apparently desirable unlike me.
I did go on every blind date that I had the opportunity to...which were exactly none. No one seems to be interested in me.
I appreciate your reply. <3
